adjudication.summary: No source-bound defects in the supplied durability guard, entrypoint ordering, mission single-flight scanner, or health/readiness predicate reuse. Hosted/Railway markers fail closed on missing/blank DATABASE_URL before ownership, migrations, listeners, and job loops; unknown FS_REMOTE_HOSTED values throw; unmarked local mode is unchanged. The scanner reserves synchronously before async readiness, records fixed workspace-scoped failure evidence, and clears reservations without unhandled rejection.
factualBasis: src/runtime-durability.ts requiresDurableState treats only '', 0, false, 1, true as valid FS_REMOTE_HOSTED values and throws INVALID_HOSTED_FLAG otherwise; durable mode is 1/true or any trimmed RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT, RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_ID, or RAILWAY_PROJECT_ID.
assertRuntimeDurability throws DURABLE_DATABASE_REQUIRED when durable mode is required and DATABASE_URL is missing or whitespace-only; it does not probe database reachability.
src/index.ts and the worker entrypoint both call assertRuntimeDurability() before loadConfig/ownership/migrations/listeners or identity/queue/mission loops.

scanMissions skips ids already in activeMissions, then constructs the run promise and activeMissions.set before any await, so a second in-process scan cannot interleave a duplicate supervisor for the same mission.

Preparation/execution failures add evidence with fixed summary and classification supervisor_failure, workspaceId from the mission, no exception text, and finally delete the reservation; scanMissions rejections are caught at the interval/initial call.

Control plane, worker, and health/readiness import the same requiresDurableState/assertRuntimeDurability helpers. Tests spawn index.ts and executor-main.ts with blank DATABASE_URL plus hosted/Railway markers and extract the production scanner for overlap and failure fixtures.
